description_en: Creates a consumer group by calling the CreateConsumerGroup operation
description_zh: 调用 CreateConsumerGroup 创建 Consumer Group
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka create-consumer-group --instance-id alikafka_pre-cn-0pp1954n0000 --consumer-id consumer_group_test --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateConsumerGroup

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call GetInstanceList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94533.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.11.6efb754byCLl4z#concept-94533-zh) to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例 ID。可调用 GetInstanceList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94533.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.11.6efb754byCLl4z#concept-94533-zh) 获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the consumer group.

The name can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).
The name must be 3 to 64 characters in length. Names that exceed 64 characters are automatically truncated.
The name cannot be modified after the consumer group is created
parameters.help_zh:
Consumer Group 名称。

只能包含字母、数字、短横线（-）、下划线（_）。
长度限制在 3-64 个字符，多于 64 个字符将被自动截取。
一旦创建后不能再修改
parameters.name: consumer_id

Code.description_en: The returned code. A value of 200 indicates success
Code.description_zh: 返回码。返回 200 为成功
